data.title: Show workspace status in list output
data.body:
## Goal

Display which bugs have active jj workspaces in `docket list` output.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket list` shows a "Workspace" column
- [ ] Bugs with active `ws-{id}` directory show the workspace name
- [ ] Bugs without workspace show `-` or empty
- [ ] Workspace detection is fast (just check directory existence)
- [ ] Works from both trunk and workspace directories

## Context

When looking at the bug list, it's valuable to see which bugs have work "in flight" with active workspaces. Currently you have to check manually with `ls ../ws-*` or similar.

Example output:
```
ID    Status      Pri   Workspace  Title
abc1  InProgress  Med   ws-abc1    Add authentication
def2  Approved    High  -          Fix payment bug
ghi3  InProgress  Low   ws-ghi3    Refactor utils
```
